description: Flat metadata schema for one tumor sequencing record from a cancer patient, capturing consent, clinical context, specimen provenance, sequencing workflow, and genomic analysis outputs for reuse and integration.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for this metadata record.

patient_id.descr: De-identified patient identifier used to link clinical and genomic records; must not contain direct personal identifiers.

specimen_id.descr: Unique identifier for the biospecimen/tumor sample used for sequencing.

matched_normal_specimen_id.descr: Identifier for the matched normal sample, if available, used to distinguish somatic from germline variants.

consent_obtained.descr: Whether informed consent for genomic sequencing and data use was obtained from the patient.

consent_scope.descr: Scope of consent, such as research use, clinical return of results, data sharing, or recontact permission.

data_sharing_permission.descr: Whether the participant consented to sharing de-identified genomic and clinical data with external researchers or repositories.

access_restriction_level.descr: Data access category, such as open, controlled, embargoed, or clinical-restricted.

diagnosis_cancer_type.descr: Primary cancer type or diagnosis, preferably using a controlled terminology such as ICD-O, OncoTree, or similar.

diagnosis_subtype.descr: More specific tumor subtype or histology, if known.

tumor_stage.descr: Clinical or pathological stage at diagnosis or sampling, using the applicable staging system.

sample_site.descr: Anatomical site from which the biopsied tumor tissue was collected.

specimen_type.descr: Specimen material type, such as biopsy, resection, blood, FFPE tissue, or fresh frozen tissue.

specimen_preservation_method.descr: How the specimen was preserved, such as fresh frozen, FFPE, cryopreserved, or liquid-stabilized.

collection_method.descr: Method of collection, such as surgical biopsy, needle biopsy, core biopsy, or resection.

anatomical_sampling_context.descr: Clinical context of the sampled lesion, such as primary tumor, metastatic lesion, local recurrence, or resistant progression site.

tumor_cellularity_percent.descr: Estimated percent tumor cells in the specimen, expressed as a percentage from 0 to 100.

necrosis_percent.descr: Estimated percent necrotic tissue in the specimen, expressed as a percentage from 0 to 100.

microdissection_performed.descr: Whether microdissection or tumor enrichment was performed prior to DNA extraction.

pathology_review_performed.descr: Whether a pathologist reviewed the specimen before sequencing.

pathology_review_date.descr: Date of pathology review, if performed.

pathology_notes.descr: Brief pathology interpretation relevant to sequencing, such as tumor purity, heterogeneity, or tissue adequacy.

patient_age_at_sampling_years.descr: Patient age in years at the time of specimen collection.

patient_sex_at_birth.descr: Sex recorded at birth, if available and relevant.

patient_gender_identity.descr: Self-reported gender identity, if collected and consented.

patient_ethnicity.descr: Ethnicity as recorded in the source clinical system or self-reported.

patient_race.descr: Race as recorded in the source clinical system or self-reported.

ancestry_inferred.descr: Genetic ancestry category or inference method output, if available.

family_history_cancer.descr: Whether a family history of cancer was recorded.

prior_malignancies.descr: Whether the patient had prior malignancies before this tumor sample was collected.

prior_cancer_details.descr: Summary of prior cancers, if applicable.

clinical_history_summary.descr: Concise summary of key clinical history relevant to the tumor and sequencing interpretation.

comorbidities_summary.descr: Summary of major comorbid conditions relevant to treatment or interpretation.

smoking_status.descr: Smoking history category, such as never, former, current, or unknown.

performance_status.descr: Clinical performance status at time of sampling, such as ECOG or Karnofsky value represented consistently.

treatment_naive_at_sampling.descr: Whether the tumor sample was collected before any systemic anticancer treatment.

prior_treatment_count.descr: Number of prior anticancer treatment regimens received before sampling.

prior_treatments_summary.descr: Summary of prior treatments, including surgery, radiotherapy, chemotherapy, targeted therapy, immunotherapy, or hormonal therapy.

current_treatment_at_sampling.descr: Treatment being received at the time of sample collection, if any.

treatment_response_status.descr: Known response status at or before sampling, such as response, stable disease, progression, or unknown.

specimen_received_date.descr: Date the specimen arrived at the processing laboratory.

dna_extraction_method.descr: Extraction protocol or kit used to isolate DNA.

dna_input_ng.descr: Amount of DNA input into library preparation, in nanograms.

dna_yield_ng.descr: Total DNA yield after extraction, in nanograms.

dna_concentration_ng_per_ul.descr: DNA concentration after extraction, in ng/µL.

dna_integrity_metric.descr: DNA integrity measure such as DIN, RIN-like score, or fragment size metric, depending on assay.

library_prep_date.descr: Date sequencing library preparation was performed.

library_prep_kit.descr: Library preparation kit or protocol used.

library_prep_type.descr: Library strategy, such as whole-genome sequencing, whole-exome sequencing, targeted panel, or RNA-seq.

target_region_definition.descr: Description of genomic regions targeted by the assay, such as exome capture kit or gene panel name.

enrichment_method.descr: Method used for target enrichment, such as hybrid capture or amplicon-based enrichment.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument platform, such as Illumina NovaSeq, NextSeq, or equivalent.

sequencing_run_id.descr: Identifier for the sequencing run or flow cell.

sequencing_date.descr: Date sequencing was completed or run initiated, depending on local convention.

read_type.descr: Read layout, such as single-end or paired-end.

read_length_bp.descr: Read length in base pairs, per read.

estimated_coverage_x.descr: Estimated mean sequencing depth/coverage over the target region, expressed as fold coverage (x).

mean_insert_size_bp.descr: Mean library insert size in base pairs.

sequencing_technology_version.descr: Version or chemistry of the sequencing platform or kit.

raw_data_file_id.descr: Identifier for the raw sequencing data file(s), such as FASTQ file identifier or accession.

processed_data_file_id.descr: Identifier for processed alignment/variant file(s), such as BAM/CRAM/VCF accession or file ID.

reference_genome_build.descr: Reference genome assembly used for alignment and variant calling, such as GRCh37/hg19 or GRCh38.

alignment_software.descr: Software used for read alignment, including tool name and version.

duplicate_marking_method.descr: Method used to mark or remove PCR duplicates.

base_quality_recalibration.descr: Whether base quality score recalibration was performed.

somatic_variant_caller.descr: Software used to call somatic SNVs/indels, including version.

copy_number_calling_tool.descr: Software used to infer copy number alterations, including version.

structural_variant_calling_tool.descr: Software used to infer structural variants or rearrangements, including version.

fusion_calling_tool.descr: Software used to detect gene fusions, if applicable, including version.

variant_annotation_tool.descr: Software used to annotate variants with functional and clinical context, including version.

somatic_snvs_count.descr: Number of somatic single-nucleotide variants identified in this record.

somatic_indels_count.descr: Number of somatic small insertions/deletions identified in this record.

copy_number_alterations_count.descr: Number of copy-number alteration events identified, if called.

structural_variants_count.descr: Number of structural variants or rearrangements identified, if called.

fusions_count.descr: Number of gene fusions identified, if called.

tumor_mutational_burden_muts_per_mb.descr: Tumor mutational burden, reported as mutations per megabase.

microsatellite_instability_status.descr: Microsatellite instability status, such as MSI-high, MSI-low, or microsatellite stable.

homologous_recombination_deficiency_stat.descr: Homologous recombination deficiency status, if assessed.

driver_variants_summary.descr: Free-text summary of key pathogenic or likely pathogenic driver alterations.

clinically_actionable_variants_summary.descr: Summary of alterations with potential therapeutic relevance.

qc_passed.descr: Whether the sample and sequencing data passed internal quality control thresholds.

qc_failure_reason.descr: Reason for QC failure or warning, if applicable.

contamination_estimate_percent.descr: Estimated cross-sample or exogenous contamination, expressed as a percentage.

tumor_purity_estimate_percent.descr: Estimated tumor purity from sequencing analysis, expressed as a percentage.

mapping_rate_percent.descr: Percentage of reads that successfully mapped to the reference genome.

duplicate_read_rate_percent.descr: Percentage of duplicate reads in the sequencing data.

mean_base_quality_score.descr: Mean base quality score across reads.

coverage_uniformity_percent.descr: Percent of target bases meeting a coverage uniformity threshold defined by the laboratory.

analysis_pipeline_name.descr: Name of the bioinformatics pipeline used for processing and analysis.

analysis_date.descr: Date the computational analysis was completed.

result_interpretation_summary.descr: Clinical or research interpretation summary of the genomic findings.

report_generated.descr: Whether a formal report was generated from this sequencing record.

report_date.descr: Date the clinical or research report was generated.

report_identifier.descr: Identifier for the report document, if generated.

secondary_use_allowed.descr: Whether the data may be reused for secondary research use under the consent and governance framework.

publication_allowed.descr: Whether de-identified data derived from this record may be used in publications.

data_provider.descr: Institution or laboratory that generated the specimen or data.

processing_site.descr: Laboratory or center where sample processing and sequencing were performed.

contact_point.descr: Contact information or institutional role for data queries, ideally a role-based email or office rather than a personal identifier.
